wish: someone should make a tool that makes a plot when I click on a graph
spec:
Turns a picture of a chart back into numbers and a fresh plot.
Open or paste a chart image, tap two known spots on each axis and type their values, then tap points on the curve; copy or download the CSV.
Does not trace curves automatically or read text on the chart; one data series at a time.
notes: Linear and log axes. Calibration projects onto each axis line, so slightly rotated scans still read correctly. Sample chart is y = x^2 for trying it without a file.
